explication: Rybbit is a privacy-focused web and product analytics application. Site users explore collected traffic and product behavior through dashboards, reports, maps, user profiles, and analysis tools; administrators manage organizations and sites. The client exposes feature-specific screens and API hooks, while the sampled server code shows session-replay ingestion, session assignment, and replay retrieval with optional object storage. README capabilities such as funnels, goals, retention, errors, and Web Vitals are represented, but their backend wiring is not established by the excerpts.
